title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 21
paragraphs: All these expeditions put together, with others added to them if any there be, do not equal this one alone. For what nation did Xerxes not lead out of Asia against Greece? What water, apart from the greatest rivers, was not drunk dry by his army? Some peoples supplied ships; others were assigned to serve in the land army; some were appointed to provide cavalry, others horse-transport vessels while themselves also serving on the expedition; some were ordered to furnish warships for the bridges, others ships for carrying provisions.
